stageMeta.title: Raw LLM (control group)
headerComment: # 3 plugins: abstract LLM service + multi-provider adapter + local driver.
# No agent-loop, no sessions, no tools. One ctx.llm.stream() call, one answer, exit.
# This is the permanent control group — all later stages grow FROM here.
stageMeta.driverQuestion: 用一句话说明插件化架构的好处

config:

      local-anthropic:
        displayName: Local Gateway
        api: anthropic-messages
        baseURL: !!js process.env.QA_BASE_URL ?? 'https://your-gateway.example'
        apiKeyEnv: QA_API_KEY
        models:
          - id: deepseek-v4-pro
